cards.title: Tiny World
cards.funFact: Microscopes help us see things that are too small for our eyes.

cards.title: Magic Magnet
cards.funFact: Magnets can attract some metals, such as iron.

cards.title: Rainbow Colors
cards.funFact: A rainbow forms when light is separated into different colors.

cards.title: Volcano Power
cards.funFact: Volcanoes can release lava, ash and gases.

cards.title: Growing Plants
cards.funFact: Plants use sunlight to make food through photosynthesis.
